description: This PHP source file defines the class `Jjwg_MapsViewQuick_Radius_Display`, which extends `SugarView`. It provides a `display()` method that generates an HTML page with an iframe pointing to a dynamically constructed URL, and displays a map address. The class is part of the custom view logic for the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Maps', specifically for quickly displaying radius-based map markers.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewQuick_Radius_Display
classes.description: A view class for displaying a map with a radius-based marker in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML output displaying a title with quick address and an iframe containing a map based on request parameters.
